card.name: Inside Fahrenheit temperature numbers
card.fires_on: Digits, decimal points and linking words inside a Fahrenheit temperature, just before the degree sign F. Seen in storage or exposure limits such as 98.6°F or 59°F to 86°F.

modes.label: Decimal inside a temperature
modes.description: The decimal point or digit within a Fahrenheit value like 98.6 or 9.5.

modes.label: Range link in Fahrenheit
modes.description: The word to or and joining two Fahrenheit values in parentheses after Celsius.

modes.label: Digit of upper Fahrenheit value
modes.description: The leading digit of the second Fahrenheit number in a range.

card.writes: It pushes toward measurement words like meter and away from foot, feet and inch, so it favors metric over imperial units.
card.plain: It fires in the middle of a Fahrenheit temperature, such as a storage range written as 59°F to 86°F.
